reference.verify_before_queries: full permutations,24base equations/cribs and97regeneration; arbitrary reference, not historical key

queries.positions: all noncrib indices ascending, one-based in output
queries.one_per_position: Let r be its reference decoding; ask exists complete alphabet pair satisfying all24base edges AND c_value(C_i)-p_value(r) != d_i mod26

classification.variable: complete counterexample independently checked for full bijections,all24cribs,target difference and97regeneration; no merely promising search hit
classification.forced: verified reference exists and difference impossible by same-component relative-potential invariant or exhausted exact global-offset CSP including isolated endpoints
classification.unresolved: per-query time/state cap or aggregate cap; never label forced on a timeout

algorithm.symmetries: If reference plaintext symbol unobserved in base P nodes and >=2unobserved P symbols, swap its coordinate with lexically first other unobserved P symbol. Otherwise if target ciphertext symbol unobserved and >=2unobserved C symbols, swap it with lexically first other unobserved C symbol. Validate complete resulting witness; no symbol-frequency/language scoring.
algorithm.component_proof: If target C node and reference P node are in same base equality component, their relative difference is fixed. Equality to target key proves no counterexample. Verified reference guarantees the equality.
algorithm.exact_search: Reuse base component potentials. Append missing disequality endpoints as isolated components in lexical (C before P) node order. Gauge first component at0. Per-side global all-different; forward-check modular disequality whenever both endpoint components assigned, or when considering one with other assigned. MRV tie larger node count then root lexical order; translations ascending. Exhaustion proves forced; first verified witness proves variable.
algorithm.completion: unobserved non-endpoint letters alphabetical into unused coordinates ascending; do not assume canonical completion is forced
algorithm.counterexample_output: full alphabet pair and target index/certificate only; no full arbitrary decoded message or concatenated reference string

resources.aggregate_stop: remaining positions unresolved if audit budget reached; snapshot incomplete if registered total cap is exceeded

controls.prior_toy_topologies: reuse GROMARK-ALPHABET-001231graphs; independent complete-permutation enumeration supplies references and exact target-difference truth
controls.query_oracle: for each satisfiable base choose first lexical pair; query every cipher symbol x every modular key; compare exists-different across all complete pairs
controls.joint_fixture: empty AB edges, referenceAB/AB, query cipherA/key0 and cipherB/key0 independently; both variable but simultaneousAAdecoding impossible by bijection. Two extra oracle queries, plus4pair joint check.

outputs: model-conditional forced letters only where exact
